user_policy: Paid market-data products are explicitly declined. JNU Research must not recommend, purchase, or depend on paid OSE/JNU intraday, tick, L2, full-order, or historical datasets unless the user later explicitly reverses this policy.
allowed_sources: User's existing Yuanta API market-data entitlement through D:\MARKET_AI_HUB
Free tiers/connected plugins already available to the user
Conditionally free official trials only if no payment obligation is created and the user separately chooses to use them
prohibited_sources: Any vendor requiring payment solely to support JNU Research

collection_semantics.exact_intraday: Collect automatically from Yuanta callbacks when actually received.
collection_semantics.streaming_tick: Collect automatically from SubscribeStockTick when callback entitlement is present.
collection_semantics.l2_depth: Collect automatically from SubscribeFiveTickA when callback entitlement is present; public docs guarantee best-five class, deeper levels only if actually observed.
collection_semantics.current_day_tick_detail: Use bounded GetStkTickDetail only as a controlled fallback/research measurement; it is not a substitute for continuous streaming history.

cloud_monitoring_rule: A ChatGPT condition-watch checks local host availability, recorder health and newly observed exact-JNU tick/depth capability. Raw broker data remains local and is never committed to the public GitHub repository.
mobile_fallback: If local host is offline, continue JNU analysis using the existing cloud/proxy fallback ladder; do not block the answer.
